entries.summary: Django backend with 11 apps: accounts, trading, indicators, signals, risk_management, payments, expert_advisors, mcp_integration, market_data, notifications, analytics
React frontend with MUI Material UI, Redux Toolkit, Recharts, TradingView widget, react-router-dom v6
React Native mobile app with Expo, React Navigation, Redux, react-native-paper
JWT authentication with simplejwt, MFA via django-otp TOTP, account lockout after 5 failed attempts
PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB, Redis for caching/channels, InfluxDB for time-series market data, Celery for async tasks
WebSocket via Django Channels for live prices, MT5 integration via MCP servers
Payment gateway is Korapay (NGN primary, GHS, KES, ZAR). Gateway client at payments/gateways/korapay.py, service layer at payments/services.py, webhook at payments/views.py
Trading config: MAX_DRAWDOWN=15%, MAX_DAILY_LOSS=3%, MAX_POSITION_SIZE=2%, TARGET_ANNUAL_GROWTH=40%
Frontend fully wired: API service with JWT interceptors, Redux slices with async thunks, all pages use real API
CI/CD via GitHub Actions (ci.yml + deploy.yml), Railway deploy with Dockerfile, Procfile, nixpacks.toml
InfluxDB pipeline: client.py (write_candle, write_candles_batch, write_tick), ingestion.py (batch buffering, MT5), queries.py (candles, price, ATR, volume profile)
Mobile app fully integrated: services/api.js with SecureStore JWT, store.js with Redux slices, all screens use real data
Monitoring: config/monitoring.py (PrometheusMetrics, middleware), config/middleware.py (timing, compression, rate-limit), docker/monitoring/ (prometheus, alerts, grafana dashboards)
Performance: config/cache.py (multi-DB Redis), trading/selectors.py (optimized queries with select_related/prefetch), config/logging_config.py (structured JSON, rotating files)
Tests: conftest.py (fixtures), tests for accounts, trading, signals, risk_management, payments (Korapay), indicators, mcp_integration, ml, strategies

anti_patterns: Avoid importing Django models in __init__.py files
Avoid creating documentation files unless explicitly requested
Avoid leaving comments unless absolutely necessary for complex logic
Always use select_related/prefetch_related for foreign key queries
Never hardcode secrets - always use os.environ.get()
Prefer Django's built-in auth system over custom solutions
Use JSON structured logging for production - not print statements
